[Benzinga news, 2026-10-27T22:02:30Z, by staff] Slide Insurance Declares Quarterly and One-Time Special Dividend
Slide Insurance's Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.07 per share and a one-time special dividend of $1.50 per share.
Slide Insurance Holdings, Inc. announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.07 per common share and a one-time special dividend of $1.50 per common share. Both dividends are payable on November 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 23, 2026. CEO Bruce Lucas stated that the special dividend reflects the company's confidence in its business model and balance sheet strength, while allowing the company to retain capital for long-term growth initiatives.
